research_protocol.starting_point: Video-original-SRT -> investment principles -> official source corroboration -> limits/conflicts -> reuse classification -> cumulative principles ledger
acceptance_gates: All video-level original SRT and SHA256 verified
All legacy claims mapped without original verdict mutation
Primary fact and timing checked at research date, else OPEN
Numerical models checked with explicit assumptions
No speaker preference promoted to universal investment principle
Only conditional educational reuse; no individual allocation/order approval
OPEN does not block video-level archive if limitations explicit
main and V3 do not change

original_srt.privacy: Do not upload whole private original SRT

claims.source_interpretation: Subscriber states KRW18m top-up may raise pension KRW250k/month; no NPS individual estimate document.
claims.v4_verification_note: NPS top-up eligibility and 119-month maximum supported; projected increase remains case only.

claims.source_interpretation: KRW18m grown over 12 years to KRW40m needs annualized ~6.88% CAGR; 6%-8% distributions imply KRW200k-267k/month gross.
claims.v4_verification_note: Illustrative return and future distribution rates are not promised; compare total return and longevity.

claims.source_interpretation: Speaker prefers NPS top-up in sample but acknowledges higher private-investment return possibility.
claims.v4_verification_note: Consider guaranteed income vs volatility, liquidity, mortality, benefit rules, personal NPS estimate.

claims.source_interpretation: Speaker proposes top-up first with existing lump sum and invest later surplus.
claims.v4_verification_note: Not a universal optimal order; emergency cash, expected pension, liquidity, and eligibility matter.

claims.source_interpretation: Subscriber plans to reinvest KRW300k monthly pension in pension funds for ten years.
claims.v4_verification_note: Personal case, no general recommendation to defer consumption.

claims.source_interpretation: Video says ten years of KRW300k/month at 7%, then calls KRW51m the year-seven value.
claims.v4_verification_note: At 7% nominal annual with monthly compounding: 7 years≈KRW32.40m; 10 years≈KRW51.93m. Correct duration label; risk not guaranteed.

claims.source_interpretation: NPS deferral adds 0.6%/month, 7.2%/year, max 36% at five years.
claims.v4_verification_note: Applicable to eligible pension deferral; not equivalent to 7.2% invested return; tax, health contribution, survivor, inflation and missed payments matter.

claims.source_interpretation: Speaker compares delayed NPS payment with reinvestment across five to ten years.
claims.v4_verification_note: Needs lifetime cash flow, survival, discount rate, taxes and year-by-year timing before choosing.

claims.source_interpretation: KRW15m private pension taxable-income threshold is not the statutory maximum account withdrawal.
claims.v4_verification_note: Separate flat KRW15m tax-choice threshold from account's formulaic pension-withdrawal limit and outside-pension treatment.

claims.source_interpretation: For eligible taxable private pension income above KRW15m, aggregated income treatment or 15% national flat tax option (typically 16.5% with local tax) may apply.
claims.v4_verification_note: Does not apply identically to all pension payments, tax-excluded basis, deferred retirement income; simplistic total 16.5% cap is not universal.

claims.source_interpretation: Compare after-tax usable cash flow rather than the absolute tax bill.
claims.v4_verification_note: Decision principle is plausible but must include market risk, withdrawal sustainability and marginal tax interactions.

claims.source_interpretation: Do not abandon all investment solely from fear of tax.
claims.v4_verification_note: Not a recommendation to maximize returns irrespective of risk; compare risk-adjusted after-tax outcomes.

claims.source_interpretation: Separate contributions with tax credit from tax-uncredited contributions and gains.
claims.v4_verification_note: Documentation of tax-excluded basis is necessary; use current law and provider account ledger.

claims.source_interpretation: Model withdrawals based on tax-excluded basis and other taxable pension sources.
claims.v4_verification_note: Statutory order: tax-excluded first, deferred retirement income next, other taxable amounts thereafter; ISA transfers require individual tax-credit checks.

claims.source_interpretation: KRW800m x assumed 6% yield /12 = KRW4m monthly is mathematically correct; claims about zero tax and constant balance are not proven.
claims.v4_verification_note: A distribution reduces NAV; 6% is not a guaranteed total return, and tax-free draw only while confirmed tax-excluded source remains.

claims.source_interpretation: Tax-excluded basis can be deemed withdrawn first before taxable contributions/profits.
claims.v4_verification_note: Not all future distributions remain tax-free indefinitely; must track remaining source basis and account statement.

claims.source_interpretation: Domestic equity ETF in general account may enjoy capital gains exemption but pension account gains taxed on pension withdrawal.
claims.v4_verification_note: ETF legal subtype, derivatives, distribution, pension account source and timing change result; avoid treating every ETF identically.

claims.source_interpretation: Foreign-asset ETF in pension account may create tax efficiencies; speaker says tax is only one consideration.
claims.v4_verification_note: Account-location choice conditional on asset mix, available products, liquidity, loss offset, costs and constraints.

claims.source_interpretation: Legacy high-crediting-rate annuity insurance may deserve retention.
claims.v4_verification_note: A cited 6.5%-7.5% guaranteed rate cannot be inferred for any actual contract; verify coverage, credited rate, surrender schedule, insurer risk.

claims.source_interpretation: Compare guaranteed legacy insurance against pension funds and asset-allocation objectives.
claims.v4_verification_note: A hypothetical 5% insurance guarantee is not universal and 10% equity return is not assured; obtain contract and fee facts.

claims.source_interpretation: ISA can be kept beyond three-year minimum or closed/reopened to potentially reuse tax preferences.
claims.v4_verification_note: Eligibility at reopening/extension, transaction friction, asset sale, tax timing, future law and client objectives matter.

claims.source_interpretation: Speaker describes using ISA gains/loss offsets in prolonged negative cases.
claims.v4_verification_note: Tax netting applies to eligible ISA profits/losses; account type and applicable nettable instruments should be checked, no general forever-loss carryforward claim.

claims.source_interpretation: 2026 ISA base exemptions KRW2m ordinary and KRW4m qualified groups; speaker prefers periodic use of tax benefit.
claims.v4_verification_note: Law confirms thresholds; frequency of renewal depends on eligibility, account return profile and transfer friction; do not force three-year rollover.

principles.title: 국민연금 추납은 개인별 추가 연금액과 가입 자격을 먼저 확인한다
principles.limitation: KRW18m/250k/month is subscriber account, not reproducible for others.
principles.application: Compare NPS written projection, break-even lifespan, cash reserve, survivor benefit, tax and investable alternative.

principles.title: 연기연금 가산율은 확정 규정이나 투자 수익률과 동일하지 않다
principles.limitation: Eligibility, foregone payments, taxes, life expectancy and household cashflow.
principles.application: Compare lifetime post-tax present values of immediate vs partial vs delayed pension.

principles.title: 사적연금 1500만원 과세기준과 법정 연금수령한도를 분리한다
principles.limitation: Different funding sources are treated differently; a 16.5% upper bound across all retirement income is false.
principles.application: Classify withdrawals by origin before calculating marginal and separate taxes.

principles.title: 연금계좌 과세제외 원금과 과세대상 수익을 나눠 기록한다
principles.limitation: Basis confirmation and ISA transfer credit status are account-specific.
principles.application: Obtain tax credit use / noncredit records and apply statutory withdrawal-source ordering.

principles.title: 월분배액은 수익률·잔고보전·비과세의 보장이 아니다
principles.limitation: 7% assumed and 6% distributions; video year-seven 51m arithmetic contradicts 7-year compounding.
principles.application: Compare total return, NAV erosion, dividend source, tax and withdrawal sustainability; correct horizon.

principles.title: ETF 세후 성과는 ETF 유형과 계좌 종류에 따라 비교한다
principles.limitation: Do not infer all ETFs are tax-free in standard accounts or that pension ETFs always dominate.
principles.application: Compare realized gains tax, pension payout tax, fees, liquidity and strategic asset mix.

principles.title: 오래된 연금저축보험을 이전하기 전 실제 보증금리와 해약조건을 확인한다
principles.limitation: No policy schedule, credited rate or surrender terms in original transcript.
principles.application: Obtain guarantee schedule, insurer, fees, tax consequences and surrender value before decision.

principles.title: ISA 만기 연장과 재가입은 손익통산·비과세 재활용·적격성을 함께 비교한다
principles.limitation: 2026 thresholds verified; long-term loss/carryover and individual re-entry must be validated.
principles.application: Before expiry, calculate realized net P/L, account and eligibility, transfer benefit and costs.

principles.title: 세금 절감보다 위험을 반영한 세후 소비·투자 성과를 종합 비교한다
principles.limitation: Speaker philosophy, not a guaranteed outcome or directive to chase returns.
principles.application: Assess after-tax cashflow, volatility, horizon, liquidity and sequence risk.

blocking_items: Subscriber-specific NPS estimate must remain unverified case
SRT example labels year seven yet uses approximately ten years' compounding; requires preserved erratum
Historical 6%-8% distribution scenario has no independent future price/yield validation
Legacy annuity insurance contracts lack verified guarantees or surrender schedule
ISA loss netting and tax choice must be account-specific
V4 principles are reusable educational knowledge, not approved personal investments
pilot.quality_notes: Independent web research confirms cited normative rules as of 2026-10-29; no individual financial suitability review or account authentication.
